output.summary: A tropical fern native to Florida, Mexico, the West Indies, Central and South America, Africa and Southeast Asia, this is the largest sword fern and can develop exceptionally long fronds. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, its young leaves are cooked and eaten as a condiment or leafy vegetable.
